text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm shopping at the mall,<n>I see Mejiro
Dober and Mejiro Ryan<n>together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: How's that one taste?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's good. Everything we've tried has<n>been tasty.
Could I have a moment<n>before I decide?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sure! Take all the time you need. Why<n>don't we go
try those samples next?
choice_data_list: Hey, you two. Doing some shopping?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... It's not really any of your<n>business. I'm
just getting a gift for<n>this lady I know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello Trainer. I received a gift from<n>a lady I
know, so we're here to get<n>her something in return.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We decided to get her something<n>sweet, but
everything's so yummy,<n>we're having a tough time
deciding.<n>Haha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We decided to get her something<n>sweet, but
everything's so yummy,<n>we're having a tough time
deciding.<n>Haha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If we were looking for something that<n>pairs well
with tea, I would've been<n>able to choose
immediately, but I feel<n>so indecisive...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's natural to fuss over a gift for<n>someone you
care about, 'specially<n>since you're so considerate
about<n>others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Me, considerate? What are you<n>talking about?
You're just teasing,<n>aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
In any case, we need to decide what<n>to get. I won't
stop trying samples<n>until I'm confident in my
choice!
choice_data_list: Well, just be careful you don't overdo it.
Well, just be careful you don't overdo it.

text_block_list.text:
In any case, we need to decide what<n>to get. I won't
stop trying samples<n>until I'm confident in my
choice!
choice_data_list: Well, just be careful you don't overdo it.
Well, just be careful you don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... The last person I need lecturing<n>me is you,
but I guess you're right...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Y-you might be right... I've<n>already eaten a
lot...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
How about we switch gears and<n>forget about food
altogether, then?<n>You can get her some cool
knickknacks or essential oils instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
How about we switch gears and<n>forget about food
altogether, then?<n>You can get her some cool
knickknacks or essential oils instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I like that idea. Let's see what the<n>shops have to
offer!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, they're able to avoid<n>overeating and
manage to find a<n>proper present.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
All right! The perfect treat for her is<n>sure to be out
there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We still haven't checked out the<n>macaron place, the
tart place, or the<n>Japanese sweets place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Right. I want to compare them with the<n>first dessert
we tried, so I'd like to<n>circle back there, actually...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! I'll come with! Let's find<n>the best
dessert for her!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Mejiro Dober manages to<n>choose the
perfect treat... but ends up<n>overeating.
